title: History
Title: History of Canada in 10 Maps
Author: Shoalts, Adam
Description: Historian, archaeologist and geographer Adam Shoalts tells the stories behind ten centuries old maps, and how they came to shape what became "Canada".

title: Lost
Title: Lost City of Z
Author: Grann, David
Subject Heading: Fawcett, Percy Harrison, 1867-1925? -- Travel -- Amazon River Region
Description: In 1925, the legendary British explorer Percy Fawcett ventured into the Amazon jungle, in search of a fabled civilization. He never returned. Over the years countless perished trying to find evidence of his party and the place he called "The Lost City of Z.

title: Botany
Title: The botany of desire : a plant's eye view of the world
Author: Pollan, Michael
Description: Michael Pollan that explores the co-evolutionary, reciprocal relationship between humans and domesticated plants. It proposes that plants use human desires—specifically sweetness, beauty, intoxication, and control—to manipulate us into spreading their genes globally.

title: Poisonwood
Title: The Poisonwood Bible: A Novel
Author: Kingsolver, Barbara
Description: The Poisonwood Bible is a story told by the wife and four daughters of Nathan Price, a fierce, evangelical Baptist who takes his family and mission to the Belgian Congo in 1959. They carry with them everything they believe they will need from home, but soon find that all of it - from garden seeds to Scripture - is calamitously transformed on African soil. What follows is a suspenseful epic of one family's tragic undoing and remarkable reconstruction over the course of three decades in postcolonial Africa.

title: Rose
Title: The Name of the Rose
Author: Eco, Umberto
Subject Heading: Monastic and religious life -- Italy -- History -- Middle Ages, 600-1500 -- Fiction

title: Under
Title: Under the Banner of Heaven: A Story of Violent Faith
Author: Krakauer, John
Description: A true-crime investigation, a study of religious extremism, and an exploration of Mormon fundamentalism.

title: Merchant
Title: Merchant kings : when companies ruled the world, 1600-1900
Author: Bown, Stephen R.
Description: Bown profiles six ruthless merchant-adventurers who ran massive monopoly trading companies with absolute, dictatorial power over global territories.

title: Arabian
Title: Arabian Sands
Author: Thesiger, Alfred
Description: The book chronicles Thesiger's expeditions crossing the Empty Quarter of the Arabian Peninsula and documents the traditional, vanishing life of the Bedouin.

title: Borneo
Title: Into the heart of Borneo : an account of a journey made in 1983 to the mountains of Batu Tiban with James Fenton
Author: O'Hanlon, Redmond
Description: Armed with survival warnings, heavy kit, and expert knowledge, naturalist Redmond O'Hanlon and poet James Fenton set out into the steaming Bornean jungle to find a rare rhinoceros—only to face an adventure none of them were prepared for.

title: Book X. L. 109.
Title: The great game : on secret service in high Asia
Author: Hopkirk, Peter
Description: Told through the real-life exploits of daring spies, explorers, and military officers who mapped secret mountain passes and courted local rulers in disguise, the book chronicles how two sprawling empires maneuvered for dominance across the deserts and trade routes leading to India.
